newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE SEVEN-MONTH CAR SALES DOWN 4.5 PCT.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE SEVEN-MONTH CAR SALES DOWN 4.5 PCT.

text.p: Philippine car sales in the first seven months of the year dropped by 4.5 percent to 48,706 units from the year-ago 50,977, the Chamber of Automotive Manufacturers of the Philippines Inc (CAMPI) said on Friday.
But the industry group said car purchases in the country for July alone increased by 1,662 units, or by 25.3 percent, to 8,228 units compared with 6,566 the previous month.

The group attributed the rise in sales to panic buying in anticipation of price increases as a result of the de facto devaluation of the peso on July 11 after which the currency had plunged by over 11 percent.
But the peso has been recovering in recent days. It opened at 28.45 to the dollar on Friday compared to a low of 30 pesos soon after the devaluation.
